propensity.model: Jeffreys-smoothed within sign(x) bin; omitted diagnostic uses constant

selection_design: same latent y and forecasts for comparing evaluation methods within arm; oracle receives exact P(R|X) only for MCAR/MAR; clean features throughout; target-dependent modes use common zero-reference squared loss or latent innovation, never a given strategy forecast

stats.unit: seed; primary conservative paired Student intervals, complete case conditional on estimability; secondary pointwise and descriptive

cost: reuse 0.02 per post-init active update, charge per planned tick; additionally count Ridge candidate fits and activations using new feedback
